_meta.rule: Every number comes from a page fetched during compilation; null = not found. Unit conversions (psi->MPa, g/cm3->kg/m3) and ratios computed from fetched tables are marked in notes. makeitfrom.com values are rounded summary figures (typically 2 significant digits).
_meta.fields: densityKgM3, modulusGPa, poisson, yieldMPa, utsMPa, fatigueMPa, elongationPct, hardness, thermalExpansionUmMK, conductivityWmK, specificHeatJkgK, meltingOrSolidusC, maxServiceTempC, strengthVsTempC [[tempC, fraction of RT strength]]

pistonAl.material: A390.0-T6 hypereutectic cast aluminium (OEM-style cast piston)
pistonAl.fatigueCondition: makeitfrom summary value; cycle count not stated
pistonAl.notes: makeitfrom gives no elevated-temperature data. strengthVsTempC is a PROXY: ratios of UTS after 100 h exposure from the NASA MSFC-398-T5 datasheet (alloy described as 'similar to SAE A390.0', permanent-mold, T5): 277 MPa @25C, 249 @150C, 221 @205C, 187 @260C, 152 @315C, 111 @370C. 1 h values are higher (263/242/215/187/145 MPa at 150/205/260/315/370C).

rodPM.material: Powder-forged Fe-Cu-C connecting rod steel (FC-0205 base + 3.0% Cu + 0.57% C, forged)
rodPM.notes: yieldMPa 723 is a COMPRESSIVE yield stress (ASTM E9) from Hoganas; tensile/fatigue testing deferred by the authors. Same paper cites Ilia et al.: yield rises 550 -> 740 MPa as Cu 2.0->3.25% and C 0.50->0.57%. Machinability blanks density 7.74-7.80 g/cm3 (not a property of the reference grade). metal-powder.tech: HS170M PF rods (3-3.5% Cu) have I-beam tensile properties 'quite similar' to direct-forged 46MnVS6mod (UTS 1157, YS 849, fatigue 543 MPa at Ps=50%) and 70MnVS4 (1217/823/496 MPa); HS170M rod fatigue 15.7% above 70MnVS4 at 50% survival (r=-2.5, shot peened). MPIF Standard 35 PF-11C60 values were not reachable.

rodBolt.material: Alloy steel bolt, ISO 898-1 property class 10.9 (4140/SCM435 Q&T)
rodBolt.fatigueCondition: makeitfrom Q&T 4140 summary value (bulk material, not a threaded fastener); cycles not stated
rodBolt.notes: Strength/elongation/hardness = ISO 898-1 class 10.9 minimums (Rm nominal 1000, min 1040; Rp0.2 nominal 900, min 940; proof stress Sp 830 MPa). TR lists HRC min 31 for 10.9 in one row; range given 31-39 HRC. Physical/thermal values and fatigue from makeitfrom Q&T 4140 (Q&T 4140 UTS 1080, YS 990, 310 HB, elongation 16%). maxServiceTempC is makeitfrom 'max temperature, mechanical' for Q&T 4140.

bearing.material: AlSn20Cu aluminium-tin bearing alloy on steel backing (bimetal)
bearing.notes: Supplier (VIIPLUS JF-20) product page; utsMPa is stated as '200 N/mm2 maximum'. Max temp 150C grease / 250C fluid lubrication. Max load inconsistent on page (30 dynamic / 90 / 100 N/mm2). Reference for a lower-Sn alloy, GB AlSn6Cu (Total Materia): density 2.6-2.9 g/cm3, E 69-79 GPa, k 160 W/mK, UTS 130-140 MPa, A 30-36%, 35-45 HB. SAE 783 datasheet not reachable. Ygmetal page blocked by robots.txt.

crank.material: 38MnVS6 (1.5231) micro-alloyed precipitation-hardening forging steel, +P / BY condition
crank.notes: EN 10267 minimums: Rp0.2 >= 520, Rm 800-950, A5 >= 12, Z >= 25. Swiss Steel 'typical with targeted analysis' 620 / 985 MPa. Ovako variants: yield min 580, Rm 850-1000. Ovako physical: E 210 GPa, nu 0.3, G 80 GPa, 7800 kg/m3, CTE 12 (20-300C), k 40-45, cp 460-480. Density/conductivity above from Swiss Steel (7.67 g/cm3, 42.6 W/mK at 20C). Transformation temps Ms 330, Ac1 720, Ac3 780 C (Ovako); stress relief <= 600C (Saarstahl). No fatigue or elevated-temperature strength in any fetched source.

gasket.material: AISI 301 stainless, full hard (MLS head gasket layers)
gasket.notes: maxServiceTempC is makeitfrom 'max temperature, mechanical' for the alloy, not for a cold-worked spring temper (cold work is lost on annealing).

valveSpring.material: Oil-tempered Cr-Si spring wire (SAE 9254 chemistry / ASTM A401 / EN 10270-2)
valveSpring.notes: utsMPa = lower bound of Pengg PENTHOR 844 (oil-tempered SiCr) for 3.5-4.5 mm wire: 1860-1960 MPa (0.4-1.3 mm: 2080-2230; 2.5-3.5 mm: 1910-2010). yieldMPa DERIVED from Pengg's statement 'Rp0.2 >= 90% of Rm' (0.9 x 1860). E 206 / G 79.5 GPa and 'up to approx. 250 C' from Pengg. ASTM A401 (Gibbs) min tensile e.g. 0.156-0.162 in: 265-290 ksi; 0.162 in = 1827-2000 MPa. Density, nu, CTE, k, cp, solidus from makeitfrom 9254, whose mechanical values are for ANNEALED bar only (YS 410, UTS 660, fatigue 280 MPa, 20% elongation, 200 HB, max mech temp 410C) - do not use those for spring wire. No fatigue or hardness for tempered wire found.

blockAl.notes: No elevated-temperature strength found (efunda 383.0 page has none).

sleeve.material: Grey cast iron ASTM A48 class 30 (ISO 200 / EN-JL1030)
sleeve.notes: Elongation 9.6% is as published by makeitfrom (unusually high for grey iron; treat with caution).

headBolt.material: Alloy steel head bolt, ISO 898-1 class 10.9 (12.9 values in notes); torque-to-yield
headBolt.notes: Shares 10.9 data with rodBolt. ISO 898-1 class 12.9: Rm nominal 1200 / min 1220, Rp0.2 nominal 1080 / min 1100, Sp 970, A min 8%, 372-434 HV, 353-412 HB, 38-44 HRC.

piston2618.notes: strengthVsTempC from DTIC AD0801499 abstract: 'At 400 F 2618 retains approximately 80 [%] of its room temperature properties after short time exposure.' Also: ~75% / 50% of yield gives 1% creep in 1000 h at 325 F / 400 F.

rod4340.notes: Single Q&T condition as published by makeitfrom; actual rod temper varies by maker.

rod300M.notes: Distributor datasheet; heat-treat condition not stated (280 ksi UTS / 230 ksi YS). Melting point given as single value 1422 C. Thermal properties not listed; 4340 values (rod4340) are a reasonable stand-in but are not sourced for 300M.

rodTitanium.fatigueCondition: makeitfrom range 530-630 MPa (annealed to STA); cycles not stated
rodTitanium.notes: Lower ends of makeitfrom ranges (annealed); STA upper ends: YS 1110, UTS 1190, fatigue 630 MPa, elongation 11%.

boltARP2000.material: ARP2000 (ARP proprietary alloy steel); physical properties from SAE 8740
boltARP2000.notes: ARP: 'ARP2000 is capable of achieving a clamp load at 220,000 psi' (= 1517 MPa, converted); 'stress corrosion and hydrogen embrittlement are typically not a problem'. ARP gives no yield, fatigue or temperature limit. ARP 8740 chrome moly: 180,000-210,000 psi tensile (1241-1448 MPa). Physical/thermal values from makeitfrom SAE 8740 (its mechanical values are annealed/cold-finished only: YS 380-570, UTS 580-670 MPa, not applicable).

boltARPL19.notes: ARP: 'capable of delivering a clamp load at 260,000 psi' (= 1793 MPa, converted); 'easily contaminated and subject to stress corrosion'; 'must be kept well-oiled and not exposed to moisture'. No physical data published; steel defaults (e.g. boltARP2000) are a stand-in, not sourced. Same ARP page: Custom Age 625+ 260-280 ksi, ARP3.5 260-280 ksi, Ti-6Al-4V 180 ksi nominal.

bearingTriMetal.material: CuPb24Sn4 (SAE 799 type) copper-lead on steel backing (tri-metal base layer)
bearingTriMetal.notes: Supplier listing; max load inconsistent (120 vs 38 N/mm2); max temp 170C (summary) or 150 grease / 250 oil. Total Materia GB CuPb24Sn visible ranges: density 7.5-9.3 g/cm3, E 100-150 GPa, 40-110 HB (rest paywalled). SAE 49 data not found; overlay (Pb-Sn) layer properties not found.

crank4340.notes: Same data as rod4340; billet cranks are often nitrided (surface hardness not sourced for 4340).

crankEN40B.material: EN40B (722M24) Cr-Mo nitriding steel, condition T
crankEN40B.notes: Condition T: Rm 850-1000, yield 680, A 13%, KCV 50 J. Condition S: 775-925 / 585 / 15% / 223-277 HB; U: 925-1075 / 755 / 12% / 269-331 HB. Page states 'high creep strength at temperatures up to 600C' (no values). 722M24 equivalence not stated on the fetched page (search results list EN40B = 722M24).

sleeveDuctile.material: Ductile (nodular) iron ASTM A536 80-55-06 (65-45-12 in notes)
sleeveDuctile.notes: 65-45-12 as-cast (Alro): min tensile 65 ksi (448 MPa), min yield 45 ksi (310 MPa), 12% elongation; no physical data. Darton MID sleeves (Drag Cartel K-series kit): 'Bulletproof Darton ductile iron', '130,000-psi tensile strength' (= 896 MPa) - vendor claim, no test data or grade given.

headStudARP2000.notes: Identical to boltARP2000 (220,000 psi clamp-load rating per ARP; physical values from SAE 8740).

gasketCopper.material: C11000 ETP copper, annealed (OS050) solid head gasket
